why: Take 3 has the most life: money paid first makes Zhou suspicious, and "Honest is extra" is the best exchange. It also keeps price and job as the sheet gives them ($70,000, chime, service bay, wait, lookout: dd8b9b4144cb97176295edbd, 824dc977c7edf50d72a1db3e). Take 2 invents a higher price and a robot collector. Take 1's meal line goes nowhere.
changes: Zhou now opens on being paid first. The Fixer's reply states the Councillor's driver and the lean month, which the take never made plain.
Moved the "we" line up to answer "We do", and cut it to two sentences, so Zhou's reason for not asking follows from what was just said.
Removed invented detail: the wages tube and late wages. Also fixed the two Zhou lines in a row at the end and the lines over two sentences.
The close merges not seeing it with sending off watchers, and "free" answers "Honest is extra". That is Zhou's one fond line, so the scene isn't cold.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Seventy thousand, paid, and I haven't heard the job. Nobody pays first.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: We do. We hear the Councillor's driver has had a lean month.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: I don't ask who "we" is. Last time, the money stopped.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: Then you're the only honest person on Apron Road, Zhou.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: Honest is extra. I've been paid for "small favours", so what, exactly?

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: At the chime, take the Councillor to the service bay. Not home.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: East yard. A couple of minutes, then I drive on.

beats.speaker: fixer
beats.line: Long enough. We get him out of the back seat.

beats.speaker: driver
beats.line: I don't see that. Anyone watching my bay, I'll send off, free.

learned: Zhou takes Vale to service bay.
